Encrypted manual backups are kept for up: Encrypted manual backups are kept for up to 30 days, including off-device copies. Data deleted from the live app may remain in a backup until that copy expires. Resolved support correspondence is deleted after 90 days unless longer retention is required by law.
You can request access, correction, eras: You can request access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability or object to processing where applicable. We may verify your identity and explain any limits that apply, including records required by law. You can complain to Finland’s Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman.
